units.source_text: 伊莎·特莱密夫人说：“埃及的处女们不亚于世界上任何国家的姑娘，是很美丽的。

en.t: Madame Isa Trelawny said, "The maidens of Egypt are as beautiful as the girls of any country in the world.

units.source_text: 但是，埃及的妻子们比世界上任何国家的妻子们都丑。

en.t: But the wives of Egypt are uglier than the wives of any other country in the world.

units.source_text: 为什么美丽的处女，顷刻之间就不得不沦为丑陋的妻子了呢？

en.t: Why must beautiful maidens, in the blink of an eye, fall into becoming ugly wives?

units.source_text: 为什么她们的美丽竟像牵牛花一般，是那样地短暂无常呢？

en.t: Why is their beauty, like a morning glory, so brief and fleeting?

units.source_text: 为什么埃及的妇女在世界上是最早衰老的呢？”

en.t: Why are the women of Egypt the first in the world to grow old?"
